requirements.text: Before edits read /.agents/notes/index.md if present, record starting revision and pre-existing uncommitted changes, and exclude unrelated work.

Step 0 verifies every repository/environment grounding row with expected versus actual and reports contradictions; stop only when design, outcomes, scope or verification must change, otherwise record and continue.
Record failing-test baseline for tests/*.test.ts and every docs/specs/*.tests/ before implementation, including Python and new contract failures separately from existing regressions.

Restrict production changes to new lib/spec-tests.ts, lib/pipeline.ts, lib/progress.ts, lib/run-summary.ts, bin/pi-implement, README.md and agent/EXTENSIONS.md. Do not change scripts/run-plan.mjs, plan prompt/gate, landing/install, tool or spec-loop skill.

Never edit, skip or weaken any protected spec .tests/ or tests/*.test.ts. Generated spec tests become frozen after their tests-only commit; existing run-plan.mjs protection must remain unchanged through planning, Luna and integration.

No mutation testing or default independent-vendor policy in this scope; no real model/network in hermetic checks. Lucas's next external-project spec run is real acceptance, not a test claimed here. Commit own work locally on starting branch; never push, change remotes, create/delete remote branches/tags/PRs/releases or rewrite others' commits.
isTestFile(file: string): boolean recognizes existing Node *.test.{ts,mts,js,mjs} and Python basename test_*.py or *_test.py patterns only.
checksNamed(file: string): number[] extracts basename v<digits> preceded by start/non-alphanumeric, with no digit after; normalize padding, do not read directory V-IDs or confuse V1 with V10.

manualEntries(text: string|null): {check: string; reason: string}[] accepts optionally bulleted V<n>: <nonempty reason> lines and normalizes check to unpadded V<n>; empty reasons do not cover a check.

specTestsGate({checks,files,manual,syntaxErrors,before}): string[] returns [] on pass; each missing check yields exactly V<n>: no test file and no MANUAL.md entry, and each out-of-range file number yields <file>: names V<k>, but the spec has V1–V<n>.
Gate rejects no recognized automated test files with an error beginning no automated checks: even when every check has a manual reason.
Gate includes every supplied syntaxErrors entry verbatim.
Gate includes one error containing pass before implementation when before is nonempty and every entry passed; mixed failing new behaviour and passing preservation files are allowed.

pathsOutside(dirty: string[], dir: string): string[] parses porcelain XY lines, uses rename destinations and returns outside path strings in order, not status lines; respect directory boundary and ignore paths under .agent/.
specTestsPrompt({spec,testsDir,checks,pythonProject,errors?}): string names the spec, directory and every V1…V<n>, the v-number test-filename rule and MANUAL.md with reasons.

Prompt offers node --experimental-strip-types --test and offers uv run --project

pytest only if pythonProject is non-null.

Prompt says adding behaviour must fail now, preserved behaviour may pass, at least one must fail; use temporary directories, no models, no network, do not edit outside testsDir and Do not implement anything. Writer reads spec/repository before any plan/code and receives nothing from a plan.
With errors, prompt appends every previous gate error explicitly as reasons the previous attempt was rejected.
parseErrors(root: string, files: string[]): string[] checks each recognized test file without running it or resolving imports, skips non-tests, and reports <file>: syntax error: <first error line>.

For .ts/.mts parse checking use module.stripTypeScriptTypes, write stripped code to a temporary .mjs and node --check it; raw node --check on .ts alone is insufficient. Missing future modules are not syntax errors; clean scratch resources.
Parse .js/.mjs with node --check and Python with python3 -m py_compile, never importing/executing test code.
PreflightInput gains optional writeTests?: boolean; true permits missing tests directory; omitted or false preserves exact legacy result and refusal text.
writeTests changes only the missing-tests blocker, not verification counting, quota, Python checks, dirty-path warnings, uncommitted spec/tests detection or other existing APIs.

Runner suppliedTests means target/testRel exists; writeTests=settings.pipeline?.writeSpecTests !== false goes to preflight; testWriter=settings.pipeline?.testWriter else planner model. False restores old refusal for a missing directory.

Writer runs as a fresh pi session at levels.planner, default Sol/planner model or pipeline.testWriter override; pi(work,model,thinking,prompt,log,db) keeps existing planner role and fresh per-round session/log paths.

Normal resolved-spec dry-run JSON adds specTests equal supplied or to be written by <testWriter> at <planner thinking>, without a model call or mutation; preserve existing downloaded-source install-only dry preview.
Fresh pipeline.json records specTests: supplied | generated alongside unchanged branch/spec/stamp/startedAt/base/baseBranch metadata.

Only generated runs lacking runDir/spec-tests.json invoke the stage, after worktree creation and before plan. Supplied tests never invoke writer. Completed generated stage is skipped on resume; legacy resumes without the marker do not start generation speculatively.
Emit spec-tests stage and allow up to three writer rounds; use specTestsPrompt with previous errors from round 2 onward, logs spec-tests-<round>.log and telemetry spec-tests-<round>-telemetry.db.

A writer nonzero ordinary exit ends run with exit 1 before planning. All rejection and failure exits flow through existing summary handling; do not alter existing global quota/interruption handling in pi().

After each writer call discard all pathsOutside testsDir via checkout/restore tracked paths and clean untracked ones, including staged outside edits; notice names discarded paths. Ignore .agent noise without committing it.
Collect generated files and MANUAL.md after cleanup, run parseErrors, and add an error for each Python test if no Python project exists.
Run each recognized test file alone through existing tests(work,[file],pythonProject); record {file,passed:boolean} for gate, without interpreting all-test group exit as each-file status.
Apply specTestsGate and write spec-tests-gate-<round>.log for each attempted gate.
Pass stops repair loop. Rejection emits errors and sends them to fresh writer on next round, at most two repairs/three attempts total, preserving per-round logs.
Third rejection exits 1 before planning with spec tests rejected after three rounds and final errors, no target base movement, and summary.md written.

Passing generation commits only the tests directory on run branch, message spec tests: SPEC-<id> (written by <model>); no writer outside edits, pre-staged unrelated paths, spec or plan enter that commit.

After passing commit write runDir/spec-tests.json {writer,rounds,files:[{file,before:fail|pass}],manual:manualEntries(...)} with repository-relative file paths and accepted round's results; resume sentinel is not written for rejected/incomplete attempts.

Continue existing planning/gate/task/integration/final grading unchanged, using generated tests now present; do not change verification count, plan prompt/gate or protection. Existing final grade runs generated or supplied .tests/.
Run record adds exactly one line after Plan: Spec tests: written by <model> before planning; see spec-tests.json in <runDir>, or Spec tests: supplied with the spec; preserve remainder of record.
lib/progress.ts ProgressStage union and accepted STAGES include spec-tests, retaining parsing validation and all old stages, events, role/cost/reduction/render behaviour.
buildSummary adds ## Spec tests before ## Plan gate, preserving existing sections, metadata, outcome, sessions and determinism; formatter remains read-only and tolerant of missing run files.
With spec-tests.json summary says Written by <writer> in <rounds> round(s), each file is labelled fail-to-pass or pass-to-pass based on before, and every manual check/reason appears on its own line.
Without spec-tests.json summary uses pipeline.json.specTests: supplied -> supplied with the spec, generated -> to be written; not finished, absent/unknown -> not recorded.

README pipeline requirements/usage lines explain a single spec markdown need not ship tests, supplied tests are retained, otherwise tests are generated/gated/frozen before planning; document pipeline.testWriter and pipeline.writeSpecTests:false without unrelated docs changes.

agent/EXTENSIONS.md Pipeline tool lines reflect same no-tests workflow/provenance/settings while preserving harness/target ownership, direct exposure, tool-local failure reporting, install/landing and plan-only behaviour.

Run protected SPEC-0020 suite and every Luna acceptance test; map V1–V12 to exact commands/test names and O1–O5 evidence. V13 runs SPEC-0019,0018,0015,0010 plus tests/*.test.ts and compares failing identities to baseline, not an invented all-green claim.

Review §7 declared exclusions explicitly: completed-stage resume existence guard, Python/no-project fixed-error branch and real model-driven external run are not exercised by protected tests; review or hermetic evidence must not be called model acceptance.

For local implementation failures repair and rerun affected groups at most three rounds. Stop/report on design-changing contradiction, suspect protected test, scope growth or repeated same failure without new testable diagnosis; never mark unrun checks passed.

Report start revision, step-0 expected/actual and baseline; each V command/output/status/repairs; O-ID evidence and §7 paths run; diff stat, full protected diffs (empty), complete changed functions and callers; deviations/unanticipated seams. Planning is not implementation; final acceptance/status follows repository policy.

tasks.brief: Stage 0 cross-file/environment evidence only; one report file, no production edit. Audit was performed by planner before writing plan/tests, not a promise that the execution engine runs Sol before Luna (it runs Luna first, Sol integrates). Start revision 42e61473b5e244a388ee0224ad8d20eafc4af3b6; git status --short empty. /.agents/notes/index.md and repo .agents/notes/index.md absent. Contract /home/george-contis/src/pi-build/lib/plan.ts byte-identical to checkout. Grounding expected/actual: preflight blocks missing tests with exact quoted text, confirmed lib/pipeline.ts; protected SPEC-0010 pipeline.test.ts expects legacy refusal without new option, confirmed; pipeline.json metadata branch/spec/stamp/startedAt/base/baseBranch confirmed bin/pi-implement; fixed STAGES confirmed lib/progress.ts; pi(work,model,thinking,prompt,log,db) and planner role confirmed; tests(work,files,pythonProject) returns code/output confirmed; run-plan.mjs final specTests run and protectedPaths/restoreProtected enforce .tests freeze, confirmed; buildSummary current headings Status/Run/Plan gate/Tasks/Final grade/Sessions confirmed. Node v24.18.0, module.stripTypeScriptTypes available function. Expected no old test failures NOT reproduced: tests/*.test.ts exit 1, 131 tests/128 pass/2 fail/1 skip. Failures: tests/markdown.test.ts:184 session recap predicate, explain gate, known.md, tier map at :191 (false !== true); tests/quota-gate-refresh.test.ts file-load failure missing @earendil-works/pi-tui imported by extensions/quota-gate.ts. This environment/baseline discrepancy does not change design; do not fix dependencies or protected tests here. Older spec Node suites all pass: 0005 7, 0006 39, 0009 13, 0010 42, 0011 23, 0014 11, 0015 22, 0018 26, 0019 29. SPEC-0014 Python test_map_views.py via uv run --project tools/map pytest -q passes 9. New SPEC-0020 protected suite exit 1, 8 entries/0 pass/8 fail (gate module missing, two summary/preflight assertions, five runner assertions). Counts/commands/log pointers in planning-checks.json; raw /tmp/spec0020-planning-nuurl0z2 logs. Baseline uv created only ignored tools/map/.venv, no tracked changes. No model-driven/network benchmark, GPU work, routing benchmark or stages 5/6 executed; unit routing-checkpoint/router-tier fixtures are part of the requested hermetic baseline. Read one sealed host note; no note edits. In report preserve constraints/out-of-scope and explain no design-changing contradiction. The spec's downloaded-source dry preview remains the existing install-only JSON early exit (SPEC-0019 protection); V12 exercises a resolved installed spec. Do not broaden installer/dry-preview behaviour or claim real external model acceptance. Final report follows S07; never mark implemented in a planning-only turn.

Stage 6.1 — create lib/spec-tests.ts only. This is a self-contained decisions/parser module, no caller changes or cross-file decisions. Read docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.md §6.1, docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.tests/gate.test.ts and docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/decisions.test.ts; interfaces and inputs are completely specified here. Export isTestFile(file:string):boolean, checksNamed(file:string):number[], manualEntries(text:string|null):{check:string;reason:string}[], pathsOutside(dirty:string[],dir:string):string[], parseErrors(root:string,files:string[]):string[], specTestsGate(input:{checks:number;files:string[];manual:string|null;syntaxErrors:string[];before:{file:string;passed:boolean}[]}):string[], specTestsPrompt(input:{spec:string;testsDir:string;checks:number;pythonProject:string|null;errors?:string[]}):string. Recognizers exactly NODE_TEST=/\.test\.(?:ts|mts|js|mjs)$/ and PY_TEST=/(?:^|\/)(?:test_[^/]*|[^/]*_test)\.py$/; no import of pipeline.ts required. checksNamed uses basename only and lowercase v + digits with start/non-alphanumeric before, no digit after, numeric padding normalized; v10 never covers V1. manualEntries accepts V: reason lines optionally bulleted - or *, trims reasons, discards empty ones, normalizes V01 to V1. Gate uses recognized files only for automation/coverage: report every missing V1..checks exactly 'V: no test file and no MANUAL.md entry'; out-of-range numbers from test filenames exactly ': names V, but the spec has V1–V' (en dash); no automated files -> error beginning 'no automated checks:'; include syntaxErrors verbatim; if before nonempty and all passed add ONE error containing 'pass before implementation'. Empty before alone is not an all-pass error; mixed pass/fail accepted. pathsOutside returns path strings (not raw porcelain lines), input order; XY + space prefix, renames select destination, C-quoted paths decode normally, tests dir exact or slash descendants inside, prefix siblings outside, .agent/ descendants ignored. No git calls or writes in that helper. Prompt names all checks individually, spec/testsDir, v/v01 example and MANUAL.md reasons, Node command 'node --experimental-strip-types --test', Python 'uv run --project

pytest' iff non-null. Include explicit phrases/semantics: 'at least one must fail', preserved behaviour may pass, temporary directories, 'no models', 'no network', 'Do not edit outside' testsDir, 'Do not implement anything'. Ask writer to read spec/repository only, not a plan; append supplied errors as previous rejection reasons. parseErrors uses built-in node:module stripTypeScriptTypes for .ts/.mts, scratch .mjs and node --check; .js/.mjs node --check; .py python3 -m py_compile; argument arrays, no shell. Do not run/import tests or resolve imports. Catch stripping/check failures, one ': syntax error: ' per bad file, skip non-tests, clean temporary files in finally (Python compile scratch allowed). Missing future imports are valid syntax. Node v24.18.0 stripTypeScriptTypes available. No new package or export needed beyond listed functions; no settings/model decisions here. Forbidden: EVERY other file, all protected/plan tests, spec/plan.json, scripts/run-plan.mjs, bin/pi-implement, notes, router, models, install/landing/tool/gate prompts. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/decisions.test.ts; do not implement runner.

Stage 6.2 — edit lib/pipeline.ts only. Read lib/pipeline.ts, docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.md §6.2, and docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/preflight.test.ts. Add writeTests?:boolean to exported PreflightInput, preserving all existing fields/types; keep preflight(input:PreflightInput):Preflight with Preflight {checks:number|null;blocking:string[];warnings:string[]}. Change ONLY missing-tests condition to !input.hasTestsDir && !input.writeTests. The exact old error string remains 'spec has no .tests/ directory: the pipeline grades against the spec's tests'. Omitted/false is byte-compatible legacy behaviour; true only suppresses this one blocker, including when other blockers/warnings exist. Leave countVerifyChecks, held/quota checks, Python/no-project detection, uncommittedSpecPaths and all warnings/results untouched. No caller inspection or adaptation is needed: runner will supply option in Sol task. All other exports/constants, in particular STOP_AND_REPORT='Report this result to the user and ask how to proceed. Implement the spec another way only if the user says so.', testEnv/testCommands, childEnv, planPrompt, install/landing and model logic are unchanged. No helper import, dependency, new settings logic or plan-prompt edit. Forbidden: every other file, bin/pi-implement, scripts/run-plan.mjs, protected and acceptance tests, spec/plan.json, notes/router/quota/model files. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/preflight.test.ts. Do not wire callers.

Stage 6.3 — edit bin/pi-implement only. Sol owns cross-file lifecycle/settings/git/test-runner integration; read spec §6.3/§7, current runner, lib/spec-tests.ts, lib/pipeline.ts preflight/testCommands/testEnv/planPrompt, lib/progress.ts and lib/run-summary.ts, and protected SPEC-0020 runner.test.ts. Add imports of declared helper functions, no changes to their files in this task. Resolve suppliedTests=existsSync(target/testRel), writeTests=settings.pipeline?.writeSpecTests!==false, testWriter=settings.pipeline?.testWriter else planner. Pass writeTests to preflight; false restores missing-directory exit 2. Normal resolved-spec dry JSON adds specTests:'supplied' or `to be written by ${testWriter} at ${levels.planner}`; keep existing downloaded-source install-only dry-preview early exit unchanged (protected SPEC-0019). Fresh metadata adds specTests supplied/generated. For resumes use saved marker; only generated AND no dir/spec-tests.json enters generation, so supplied and legacy markerless resumes do not invoke writer. Place stage after worktree creation before stage('plan'), no planning output/session or code given to writer. Emit stage('spec-tests'); rounds 1..3 invoke existing pi(work,testWriter,levels.planner,specTestsPrompt(...),dir/spec-tests-<round>.log,dir/spec-tests-<round>-telemetry.db) with errors from previous rejected gate. Each pi call already creates fresh session directory/planner role; retain that plumbing and existing global hold/interruption semantics, ordinary nonzero return exits 1. After writer: get raw porcelain preserving first leading status column; use pathsOutside; safely discard both tracked/staged outside edits and untracked outside paths, emit notice naming them. Use existing git helpers/argument arrays with '--' boundaries; inspect tracked status when choosing restore/checkout vs clean, do not sweep testsDir, target repo or .agent artifacts. Any ignored .agent changes remain OUT of commit. Recollect files/recognized automation/manual text; parseErrors + explicit Python/no-project error, run each test file alone through tests(work,[file],pythonProject), collect {file,passed:result.code===0}. Call gate; write spec-tests-gate-<round>.log even on pass. Emit rejection errors, next writer gets errors; third rejection exit('spec tests rejected after three rounds'+errors,1) before planning, summary written by finish. At pass, stage/add only testRel then use path-scoped commit so even writer-staged .agent/outside work cannot leak; exact message `spec tests: SPEC-${spec.id} (written by ${testWriter})`. Only after commit write spec-tests.json {writer:testWriter,rounds:<accepted round>,files:<accepted recognized per-file results mapped to before:'fail'|'pass'>,manual:manualEntries(text)}; relative paths. Never write sentinel on failed/partial stage. Recollect spec tests after generation where necessary, continue existing plan count/prompt/gate unchanged. Existing run-plan grades/protects .tests, do not touch it. Run record adds immediately after Plan line: `Spec tests: written by <model> before planning; see spec-tests.json in <runDir>` using saved record.writer on resume (not potentially changed setting), otherwise `Spec tests: supplied with the spec`. Preserve all other metadata/record/landing/install/tool/model/continuation semantics. No relaxation of protected paths; planning must see committed generated tests. Protected runner tests cover writer-first commit, cleanup, two repairs, third rejection, supplied and dry; additionally review custom writer/planner thinking, nonzero writer, saved-complete resume, Python/no-project branch and full run-record ordering as not all protected paths run through integration. No real model-driven run. Do not edit another file or weaken tests to accommodate a failure.

Stage 6.4 progress — edit lib/progress.ts only. Read that file and docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/progress.test.ts. Extend exported ProgressStage union and private STAGES to include exactly one new accepted stage 'spec-tests'. Existing stages remain 'preflight','plan','gate','tasks','integration','grade','handoff','install','land'. Preserve exported signatures parseProgressLine(line:string):ProgressEvent|null, initialProgress(spec:string):ProgressState, reduceProgress(state:ProgressState,event:ProgressEvent):ProgressState, renderProgress(state:ProgressState,expanded:boolean):string[], progressSummary(state:ProgressState):string. Existing stage reducer/renderers should already handle the new union value without special-case code. Keep all existing event validation, roles, cost totals, done fields, childEventToProgress/finalText and rendering byte-compatible; unknown/malformed stage lines still return null. No new imports, dependencies, settings or caller reasoning required. Runner's stage emission is Sol's task, not yours. Forbidden: EVERY other file, caller/extension/tool, all protected and plan tests, spec/plan.json, notes/settings/router/quota/models and scripts/run-plan.mjs. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/progress.test.ts.

Stage 6.4 summary — edit lib/run-summary.ts only. Read lib/run-summary.ts, docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.md §6.4 and docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/summary.test.ts. Only exported interface remains buildSummary(input:{runDir:string;outcome:{ok:boolean;stage:string;reason:string;next?:string;landed?:string;branch?:string}}):string. Add section exactly '## Spec tests' before existing '## Plan gate', after Run. Input schemas supplied here: pipeline.json already has spec/branch/base/baseBranch/startedAt etc and gains optional specTests:'supplied'|'generated'; spec-tests.json is {writer:string,rounds:number,files:{file:string,before:'fail'|'pass'}[],manual:{check:string,reason:string}[]}. Do not infer producer state or import other repository code. Use existing readJson helper. When spec-tests.json exists/decodes, say exactly 'Written by <writer> in <rounds> round(s)', one line per files entry with file and before==='fail' ? 'fail-to-pass' : 'pass-to-pass', one line per manual entry with check/reason. This evidence takes precedence over metadata. No artifact: supplied -> 'supplied with the spec'; generated -> 'to be written; not finished'; absent/unknown/missing metadata -> 'not recorded'. No throws on missing/invalid JSON; retain current tolerant read-only deterministic behaviour, no subprocess, model, network, filesystem/DB write or new package. ALL other output is unchanged: Status/Run/gate logs/Tasks/Final grade/Sessions/integration report, SQLite totals, order, cost formatting, outcome text and missing-file fallbacks. No requirement to import manualEntries, no producer/interface decision left open. Forbidden: every other file, runner, all tests (including acceptance), spec/plan.json, notes, settings/router/models/tool/landing and scripts/run-plan.mjs. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.plan/summary.test.ts.

Documentation after §6: edit only README.md Developing with pi requirements/usage lines. Sol verifies cross-file claims against runner/helper settings. Remove unconditional sibling .tests/ prerequisite for local and downloaded markdown specs. Say supplied tests are kept; missing tests are written from spec/repository in a fresh planner-level session, gated with at least one failing before implementation, and committed/frozen before planning. Note generated provenance in spec-tests.json/summary/run record, pipeline.testWriter optional override defaults to planner model, pipeline.writeSpecTests:false restores refusal. Preserve downloaded installation/numbering, safe landing/opt-out, dry preview, resume, planOnly and failure instructions. No unrelated prose or API-doc expansion, no tool/prompt or installer edits.

Documentation: edit only agent/EXTENSIONS.md Pipeline tool lines after reading actual runner/settings/README. Clarify plain .md without sibling tests is accepted by default; supplied tests are kept, missing tests are generated/gated/frozen before planning and labelled in spec-tests.json, summary and run record. Mention pipeline.testWriter override and pipeline.writeSpecTests:false refusal opt-out succinctly. Preserve directly exposed tool/no subscribed events, harness/target ownership, existing install/landing/summary/planOnly and tool-local failure-reporting contracts. This is documentation only; do not edit extensions/pipeline.ts or any other file.

Final verification/evidence, one report file; update S00 evidence without claiming implementation in a planning-only turn. Execution engine runs Luna first and then Sol implements/integrates all Sol tasks; task listing follows spec stages, not a promise to invoke integration before Luna. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0020-write-spec-tests-when-a-spec-has-none.tests/*.ts and each .plan acceptance test. V1 gate coverage/numeric boundaries, V2 all-manual/all-pass/syntax gate, V3 outside paths, V4 prompt, V5 parse checks are named cases in protected gate.test.ts; V6/V7 cases in preflight-summary.test.ts; V8–V12 the five runner.test.ts cases in order. V13: run node --experimental-strip-types --test for SPEC-0019, SPEC-0018, SPEC-0015, SPEC-0010 .tests/*.ts plus tests/*.test.ts. Compare exact failing identities with planning-checks.json: older spec suites zero failures; unit baseline markdown assertion and quota-gate-refresh missing pi-tui only. Do not fix/skip protected failures or install dependencies to fake baseline equality. Retain older Node/Python baseline evidence. Ensure all four Luna test FILES fail before implementation (module-not-found for new decisions module is expected; other files must fail behavioural assertions), validatePlan(plan,13) and undeclaredImports each owner return no errors, and no implementation exists in planning diff. During actual implementation rerun affected groups at most three repair rounds; stop on design-changing contradiction, protected test issue, scope growth or same failure without new diagnosis. Map O1–O5 and §7 paths to hermetic outputs; actual external model-driven acceptance remains Lucas's next real run. Review custom writer override and planner thinking, nonzero writer exit, resume completed marker, Python/no-project fixed error, run-record generated/supplied line, path-only commit despite outside staging and tests freeze through existing grade. Protected tests intentionally do not exercise full integration or resume guard; label static review or added hermetic evidence accurately, never call unrun checks passed. Include start revision, expected/actual grounding, baseline, each V command/output/status and repairs, git diff --stat, full protected diff (empty), complete changed functions with callers, deviations/unanticipated seams. Commit only own work locally on starting branch, no push/remotes/rewrite. Do not mark status implemented until actual final acceptance under repository policy.
